schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE R (A INT, B INT);
q1: SELECT X.A + X.B, X.A / X.B AS A FROM R AS X
q2: SELECT Y.A + Y.B, Y.A / Y.B AS A FROM R AS Y
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT X.A + X.B, X.A / X.B AS A FROM R AS X
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT Y.A + Y.B, Y.A / Y.B AS A FROM R AS Y
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are semantically equivalent because they perform the same operations on the same table with different aliases (X and Y). The aliases do not affect the computation or result of the query.
